_comment: Tag mapping for migrate_vault_frontmatter.py. Copy this file to tag-map.json (in the same directory) and edit it to fit your vault's taxonomy. The script looks for tag-map.json next to itself; if that file is absent, no tags are added (pages get tagged []).

_schema.domain_map: Exact match. Key = normalized value from the page's '**Domain(s):**' line (lowercased, spaces->hyphens). Value = tag to apply.
_schema.folder_map: Fallback used only when the page has NO '**Domain(s):**' line. Key = parent folder name. Value = tag to apply.
_schema.keyword_map: Substring match against the normalized '**Domain(s):**' value. First hit wins. Key = substring to search for. Value = tag to apply.

_example_taxonomy_note: The example values below come from a personal-brain vault about health and identity. Replace with the tag set that fits your vault. For a social-content creator vault you might use: 'hooks', 'frameworks', 'psychology', 'voice', 'topics'.
